name: plexbook
description: Audiobook player for Plex and local files

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p1='node_modules/@capacitor/filesystem/android/build.gradle';if(fs.existsSync(p1)){let c=fs.readFileSync(p1,'utf8');if(!c.includes('project.extensions.findByName')){c=c.replace('apply plugin: \'kotlin-android\'', 'if (!project.extensions.findByName(\'kotlin\')) { apply plugin: \'kotlin-android\' }');fs.writeFileSync(p1,c);}}const p2='node_modules/@capacitor/filesystem/android/src/main/kotlin/com/capacitorjs/plugins/filesystem/LegacyFilesystemImplementation.kt';if(fs.existsSync(p2)){let c=fs.readFileSync(p2,'utf8');if(!c.includes('file?.parentFile?.mkdirs()')){c=c.replace('val fileOutputStream = FileOutputStream(file, false)', 'file?.parentFile?.mkdirs()\n        val fileOutputStream = FileOutputStream(file, false)');fs.writeFileSync(p2,c);}}"

author: Chris Clark
